title: Corvid's Essential Totem Texture
description: Replaces the "Totem of Undying" to a kitty cat or also known as the "Totem of Nine Lives".
body:
### Replaces the "Totem of Undying" to the "Totem of Nine Lives". 

Replaces Totem with a black minecraft kitty.

 This resource pack was made for Corvid and member of the Vesprine SMP

If any issues come up please DM @noobsavior12 on discord

Also the model is made by me, the one and only noob
